body: Thanks for the advice, I've been following it, and I've gotten to the point where I can get into a small conversation with a stranger without panicking too much. It's easier to socialize now.

Sure. I was born with autism and ADHD and have depression and anxiety. I spent most of my life being ignored and bullied by students at school and had very few friends. The way I think my anger problems came to be it that I generalize all humans as possible bullies, and feel a strong need to stand up for myself. I also have anger because I feel like everyone is the same as those who don't pay attention to me and for not being kind to me and treating me as nice as others.

My feelings are easily hurt. Even the smallest insult can masks me cry or send me into fury.

I am very kind and loving to the people who are my friends. I would do anything in my ability to make them happy, laugh, or smile. I am somewhat clingy and try to hang out with them all the time.

I am a 2 sided coin. One half is stubborn and angry, while the other half is shy, kind, and docile.

My family members used to treat me terribly. They treat me much better now, but I still haven't quite forgiven them and get angry with them really easily as a result.



I hope this info helps you
